results.body:
eureka:
  client:
    service-url:
      defaultZone: http://localhost:8761/eureka/
  instance:
    prefer-ip-address: true
management:
  endpoints:
    web:
      exposure:
        include: health,info,metrics,env,beans,mappings
  endpoint:
    health:
      show-details: always
    env:
      show-values: never
  info:
    env:
      enabled: true
patitas:
  config-source: patitas-config
server:
  port: 8081
spring:
  datasource:
    url: jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/dueno_db
    username: patitas
    password: ''
    driver-class-name: com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
  jpa:
    hibernate:
      ddl-auto: update
    show-sql: true
    open-in-view: false
info:
  app:
    name: ms-dueno
    description: Microservicio de gestión de dueños - Patitas Felices
    version: 1.0.0
